# docs/templates

Copy-source templates used by the leader when creating issues/comments/PRs/folder READMEs.
Copy VERBATIM and fill placeholders; do not "improve" structure ad hoc - change the
template here first so every instance stays uniform.

## Contents / rules
- `issue.md` - managed-issue body (form marker + fixed headings).
- `comments.md` - the five comment types with their first-line markers.
- `PR.md` - PR body (Refs/Closes placement, verification, tier record).
- `folder-README.md` - D19 folder README skeleton.
- Templates are referenced by `docs/issues.md` and AGENTS.md; keep them in sync with the
  standard documents.
